explanation: Live prediction allows missing lineups and falls back when not confirmed. Training fetches historical lineups after the fact, so the source timing is not proven pre-first-pitch and may encode actual lineup information that was unavailable for some games at prediction time.
recommended_fix: Store immutable pregame lineup snapshots with fetch timestamp, train from those snapshots, and keep a separate no-lineup fallback path.

explanation: The training join derives actual lineups from plate appearances and starter handedness from same-game pitches. That uses information produced by the game being predicted, even though BvP history itself is as-of filtered.
recommended_fix: Replace training source with pregame lineup snapshots and probable starter hand from schedule data, or remove these features until audited pregame snapshots exist.

explanation: The training join calls fetch_pitch_quality(season) once per season and applies that season snapshot to every game, so early-season games can see future pitch-quality information. Live prediction also lacks a recorded as-of cutoff.
recommended_fix: Cache pitch-quality snapshots by as_of date and join the latest snapshot strictly before first pitch, or use only prior-season pitch-quality features.
